title: OnlyHotbar
description: Restricts player inventory to hotbar only while keeping armor, offhand and crafting slots accessible.
body:
# OnlyHotbar

OnlyHotbar is a simple lightweight plugin that completely restricts the player's inventory, leaving only the 9 hotbar slots available for regular item storage and gameplay.

Armor slots, the offhand slot and the entire 2x2 crafting area remain fully accessible and work exactly like in normal gameplay.

![HotbarOnly Inventory Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6773fe7c0db3e3a1354c73cb0f63f81678b1f30c.png)
